answer: Agents earn identity only by locking scarce collateral that existing members co-sign as a surety ledge. If a newcomer is caught faking identity, the slash spreads like a ripple to every voucher, so trust becomes transitively priced. A Sybil attacker must then fund one independent stake per fake agent or bribe distinct guarantors who risk their own capital. A thousand fake nodes therefore cost a thousand bonds, not one signature, and at dawn each new epoch re-prices that cost.
